### Services in Addition to General Practice Veterinary Medicine

Fear Free Veterinarian: Through a well designed hospital environment, technical training and specialized resources we minimize fear, anxiety, and stress for dogs and cats under our care.

Integrative (East/West) Approach: We focus on nutrition and herbal therapy for holistic pet care. Multi-modal pain management, including acupuncture, are also used for chronic pain

### When Your Pet Needs a Bit More Care

Oncology: If surgery is not curative for a type of cancer, Chinese herbal medicine and/or chemotherapy treatments are used. Acupuncture and/or herbal medicine are also used to minimize any treatment side effects and to boost the immune system.

Dentistry: A thorough dental assessment and treatment plan can only be achieved with a pet under anesthesia. Oral exams, charting, dental radiographs, cleaning, and polishing are used to properly clean (above and below the gum line) and then treat periodontal disease to extend the health and life of your pet.

# Pet Chemotherapy Administration & Monitoring

At Mountain View Veterinary Health Centers, we recognize the emotional depth of the bond you share with your pets, and that’s why we’re dedicated to providing exceptional care that resonates with both your heart and theirs.

Image: contact img

Image: dog in tall grass

## Unwavering Compassion and Expertise

Recognizing the profound impact of a pet’s cancer diagnosis, we approach each case with deep empathy. We understand this journey’s emotional turbulence and provide unwavering support to you and your beloved companion.

The administration of chemotherapy transcends mere medical practice; it’s a skillful art that demands meticulousness and proficiency. Our veterinary experts deeply understand this art, skillfully crafting treatment regimens that align with your pet’s requirements. By tailoring therapies to your companion’s individual needs, we strive to achieve the most favorable outcomes. Trust us to guide you and your pet through this challenging process with empathy and expertise.

## Benefits for Your Beloved Pet

Image: paw print icon

### Enhanced Quality of Life

Chemotherapy, when administered and monitored effectively, can significantly improve your pet’s quality of life. Our focus on over-the-top chemotherapy administration aims to minimize side effects while maximizing the treatment’s effectiveness, allowing your pet to enjoy life to the fullest.

Image: paw print light blue

### Individualized Attention

We believe that individualized care is key to successful treatment. Our vigilant monitoring ensures we catch any changes or concerns early on, giving your pet the best chance to recover successfully.

Image: paw print light blue

### Emotional Well-being

Pets thrive on love and routine. Our meticulous monitoring and care address their physical well-being and emotional support, helping them maintain a sense of security and comfort during treatment.

## Discover the Extraordinary

At Mountain View Veterinary Health Centers, our role transcends mere caregiving; we consider ourselves active partners in your beloved pet’s health voyage. Our dedication to providing compassionate chemotherapy administration and diligent monitoring surpasses routine medical tasks; it embraces the profound emotional connection you and your furry companion share. We understand that your pet is a patient and a cherished family member. With this understanding, we strive to provide top-notch medical care and support and strengthen the bond you share with your pet.

We believe in a holistic approach acknowledging the significance of emotional well-being and physical health, ensuring you and your pet feel valued, heard, and cared for throughout this journey.

This November marks the ninth 
anniversary of Jessy Topham’s first 
visit to the Flint Animal Cancer Center.  
Following a diagnosis of osteosarcoma 
in Jessy’s right maxilla, Jessy’s mom, 
Allison, traveled with Jessy from their 
home in Utah to seek treatment at the 
FACC. 
Over several months, Jessy 
underwent surgery, radiation, and 
chemotherapy treatments. During 
that time, Allison spent many hours 
at the FACC and met a variety of pet 
families, some of whom were anxious 
not only about the health of their pets 
but also about the cost of treatment. 
Allison empathized with those families, 
grateful that she was able to afford 
Jessy’s care but heartbroken for those 
she met. 
Jessy fought a courageous 
battle with cancer for two years and 
during that time enjoyed many of 
her favorite things in life, including
